text:
maria: Hey team — pushed fixes for the comments on PR #482. Split the perf tweak into a separate commit and added an a11y label + short summary in the PR description. PTAL when you get a sec: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/482

alex: Quick q — did you keep the HTTP client change as a separate commit? prefer squash or keep history here?

maria: Kept them separate (perf change + lint). Happy to squash if maintainers want. I also added a one-line changelog to the PR body.

chen: LGTM on the core logic. Left one tiny nit about header parsing — I pushed a fix in the latest commit.

jon: Ran a quick smoke against staging just now, no obvious regressions. Summary:
```
ok: 200 responses
median latency: 48ms
errors: 0
```
Canary slot still available tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: canary-bot: reservation created for 2025-04-28 09:00 UTC (duration: 2h) — use `/reserve` to adjust.

alex: @maria two small asks before I approve: rebase onto main and add an AUTHORS line for the perf change.

maria: Rebased and pushed; added AUTHORS entry. Re-requesting review from @alex and @chen :pray: 

ci-bot: ci: all checks passed — unit, integration, and linters are green.

jon: We need 2 approvals to merge. Pinging @platform-team to grab a merge custodian if the canary window slips.

maria: Noted. If no further comments by EOD I'll merge after the canary run. Thanks all :rocket:
